proposed_fields.description: Structured list of office/center locations the practice operates or publicly lists, including address and optional phone/fax per site.
proposed_fields.why_needed: Existing catalog lacks a dedicated structured field to capture multiple office locations with per-site contact details; that drives routing decisions (sales territory, on-site demo feasibility, and localized outreach).

proposed_fields.description: Published fax numbers used for referral or general intake as observed on official pages or directories.
proposed_fields.why_needed: Referral intake commonly uses fax; capturing all published fax numbers and their sources helps escalation and integration planning where fax remains a critical intake channel.

proposed_fields.description: Explicit summary of observed EHR / practice-management vendor relationships and key products in use.
proposed_fields.why_needed: Understanding the installed EHR/vendor (and patient-communication products like Klara) is essential for technical targeting and integration assessments; no existing single field captures both vendor and component products.

proposed_fields.description: Summary of practice scale including number of practices, endoscopy centers, physician count, and daily patient volume where reported.
proposed_fields.why_needed: Sales and solutions teams need a concise operational scale metric (patients/day, centers, physician count) to prioritize outreach and size-fit assessments beyond headcount.
